description: We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting the significant impact you will have on patient care and operational excellence. We are looking to fill this position promptly with a passionate and qualified professional.As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, regulatory compliance, and staff development. This is an exceptional opportunity to shape the future of nursing services and contribute to a supportive and resident-focused environment. Join a team committed to delivering outstanding healthcare outcomes.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Proven experience in nursing leadership, preferably within a skilled nursing facility.
Strong understanding of long-term care regulations and best practices.
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 to $95,000, compensation based on experience.
